description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.

If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.


About the Role

Leads environmental, health, and safety, community relations, and sustainability for Lambda’s datacenter construction and operations. Builds the (Environmental, Health & Safety) EHS management system and reporting, governs general contractor safety performance, prepares sites for safe operations at turnover, and delivers the sustainability and community commitments that customers and host communities expect.


What You’ll Do

EHS management system and governance

  • Define EHS standards, incident management, OSHA recordkeeping, management of change, and reporting definitions across construction and operations.

  • Set safety KPIs and run weekly executive reporting; choose and manage the EHS technology platform and annual budget.

Construction EHS and contractor governance

  • Partner with general contractor EHS leaders on site-specific safety plans, simultaneous-operations protocols, and hazard controls.

  • Provide EHS and sustainability input on designs and lead incident investigation and root-cause analysis.

Turnover and operations readiness

  • Own EHS readiness for the construction-to-operations handover with DC MEP Operations, including review of operating and emergency procedures.

Regulatory compliance and emergency preparedness

  • Ensure federal and state EHS compliance through audit and risk processes; coordinate air and environmental permits with Power and Site Development.

  • Lead emergency preparedness with local emergency services, including medical response and severe-weather planning, and workforce health programs.

Sustainability and ESG

  • Set the sustainability charter and meet customer sustainability requirements, including carbon-free energy, greenhouse gas reporting (Scope 1–3), and supplier data.

  • Direct water, energy, waste, emissions, and materials reporting, and plan management-system and green building certifications such as ISO 14001, ISO 50001, and LEED.

Community relations

  • Build relationships with local officials, emergency services, health systems, and community groups near each site.

  • Develop community investment programs and take them through internal compliance and finance approval.

You

  • Experience in EHS leadership, including large construction or industrial projects and general contractor oversight.

  • Experience building EHS programs, safety metrics, and executive reporting across multiple sites or states.

  • Strong knowledge of OSHA and environmental regulatory requirements and incident investigation methods.

  • Experience with sustainability or ESG reporting and customer sustainability requirements.

  • Bachelor’s degree in EHS, engineering, public health, or a related field.

Nice to Have

  • Airline Industry, private health, energy, or other large-scale infrastructure construction experience.

  • Occupational health or medical background; CSP, CIH, or similar certification.

  • ISO 14001/45001/50001 or LEED experience.

  • Experience leading community engagement in rural or remote host communities.

Key Interfaces

Construction · DC MEP Operations · Power and Site Development · Engineering · general contractors · customers · local officials and community organizations

First-Year Success Measures

  • EHS management system, KPIs, and weekly reporting in place for all active construction sites.

  • Turnover EHS checklist adopted by Construction and DC MEP Operations.

  • Sustainability charter and community engagement plan agreed for each active site.

Salary Range Information

The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.

About Lambda

  • Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast

  • Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove

  • We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG

  • Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers

  • We offer generous cash & equity compensation

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents

  • Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles

  • 401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees)

  • Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use
